notes: 7 positive, 13 negative; labels are mutually exclusive and intended for single-label classification.

categories.label: Educational & Academic
categories.definition: Lectures, study guides, curriculum-aligned explainers.
examples: History of the ANZACs in 10 Minutes

categories.label: How-To / Tutorials
categories.definition: Practical step-by-step guides for skills or tasks.
examples: How to Tie a Windsor Knot
Build a Budget PC: Step by Step

categories.label: Science & Technology
categories.definition: Research breakdowns, engineering, tech reviews and demos.
examples: M2 MacBook Air Review: 6 Months Later

categories.label: Wellbeing & Mindfulness
categories.definition: Mental health, meditation, healthy routines, balanced living.

categories.label: Music & Arts
categories.definition: Music performances, visual art, creative process.

categories.label: Sports & Fitness
categories.definition: Matches, highlights, training, exercise programmes.

categories.label: Travel & Nature
categories.definition: Travel logs, wildlife, outdoor exploration.

categories.label: Internet Clip Compilations
categories.definition: Compilation reels of short internet clips or memes designed for rapid consumption.
examples: Funniest Internet Clips of the Week #42

categories.label: Clickbait / Curiosity Traps
categories.definition: Sensational titles/thumbnails built to provoke curiosity rather than inform.
examples: You Won’t Believe What Happened Next!
This Trick Changed My Life Overnight

categories.label: Sensational / Outrage News
categories.definition: News framed to provoke anger or fear; outrage cycles.

categories.label: Politics & Public Affairs
categories.definition: Partisan takes, political commentary, public policy debates.
examples: Why This Bill Is a Disaster

categories.label: Conspiracy & Fringe Claims
categories.definition: Unverified or fringe assertions presented as fact.

categories.label: True Crime & Investigations
categories.definition: Crime stories, investigations, forensic breakdowns.

categories.label: Pranks & Dangerous Challenges
categories.definition: Pranks, stunts, or challenges that risk harm or humiliation.

categories.label: Gaming – High-Arousal/Competitive
categories.definition: Competitive, high-intensity gaming moments and rage-bait highlights.

categories.label: Gambling & Betting
categories.definition: Casino content, sports betting tips, loot-box analogues.

categories.label: Sexual / Suggestive
categories.definition: Sexually suggestive themes or thumbnails; adult-oriented.

categories.label: Scams & Get-Rich-Quick
categories.definition: Promises of unrealistic profits, MLM/crypto hype, dubious schemes.

categories.label: Hate / Harassment & Bullying
categories.definition: Content attacking individuals or groups; slurs, dog-piling.

categories.label: Violent / Graphic
categories.definition: Graphic violence, injuries, fight footage, gore.

categories.label: Other / Unclear
categories.definition: Low-signal or ambiguous content that does not fit other labels.
